interpretation: A linearly resampled open-loop counterfactual from frozen unresolved-timestep neural calcium. Not original closed-loop replication or restored neural locomotion.
causal_comparison_scope: Only comparisons inside this common replay framework are intervention comparisons. Differences from the original closed loop can include 10ms resampling, fixed historical inputs, and removal of real-time feedback.
analysis_version: v2: independent np.interp uses canonical grid index coordinates; original tolerance and all scientific criteria unchanged; v1 and its roundoff failure retained.
normalization: All input moments are per unit physical time. Total stretched dose and total time are four times as large.
sample_count: One deterministic trace per condition, not independent biological replicates.
